//live: `test/live/paneViewer.live.test.tsx` is deliberately NOT in the list below, and the reason is a collision between two global worlds rather than a defect. It imports packages/herdr-client-ts/test/live/harness.ts, which spawns a process with `env: Record<string, string>`; that is correct Node and it type-checks green inside its own package (`pnpm -C packages/herdr-client-ts run typecheck`). Inside a *mobile* program it does not, because expo's global augmentation declares `process.env.NODE_ENV` as REQUIRED (node_modules/expo/types/metro-require.d.ts:9) and that arrives here through the route file's `expo-router` import. TypeScript reports errors in imported files regardless of `exclude`, so there is no way to check the live test in this program without also re-checking a Node harness against Metro's `ProcessEnv`. Verified 2026-08-22 that harness.ts:116 is the ONLY remaining error under a live-only project — the live test itself is type-clean.
